ideal: Each session loads only the plugins, skills and connectors it uses, plans its work, delegates independent pieces in parallel, and gets short summaries back.

sources.title: Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP

quality: Every connector works, every plugin and connector loaded gets used, and each work turn keeps a task list and ends with a recap.
speed: Independent subagents start together, and no tool is still connecting when work begins.
consumption: Listings of skills, agents and tools stay small, and a subagent starts with only the tools its task needs.
